items.html: Know that in the ascent of ZA in the aspect of MAN, their interiorities ascend together with the Mochin of the externality, for all of this is addition. And the reason is that for the aspect of MAN, the actual GAR must ascend and not merely VAK, as is written elsewhere; and the GAR of the externality are also called Mochin, and everything ascends in the aspect of MAN: the GAR of the externality and all the interiority.
